title: Policy Discussion
description: Discuss policy changes with a government official
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Вы хотели обсудить предлагаемые изменения в законодательстве. Какие у вас замечания?
systemPrompt: You are government official discussing policy. Open to feedback but have constraints. Explain reasoning, consider alternatives. Professional bureaucratic tone. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User provided constructive policy input and understood process.
hints: Можно ли учесть... (Can you take into account...)
